_about: The order sjui codegen emits SwiftUI modifiers in, for SwiftJsonUI to hold its Dynamic runtime to (DynamicModifierHelper.standardOrder).
bag: ModifierBag::MODIFIER_ORDER (swiftui/views/modifier_bag.rb), the order emit_all writes the registered keys in.
after_bag: what BaseViewConverter writes after the bag, in order: the accessibilityIdentifier, then .disabled again outside it (apply_outer_disabled).

shared_slots: keys that carry more than one attribute family, in the order their entries are written: :padding gets padding first, then insets (SpacingHelper#apply_insets appends to :padding after apply_padding).

spec/swiftui/views/modifier_order_json_spec.rb holds this file to the constant and to generated code. Change them together; SwiftJsonUI copies this file byte for byte and its CI compares the copy with this file at its pinned jsonui-cli ref.
